packageRules.description: Keep Spring Cloud train and Spring Cloud Config in a single PR - project.version is derived from spring-cloud-config, so these must move together.
Spring Boot moves independently and can require code changes (e.g. #147), so keep it as its own PR.
Never auto-merge - bumps need a real CI run (multi-arch image build + testcontainers integration matrix) and occasional code changes before merging.
